_comment: Repo defaults for the model placement registry. Shape only: unit/service names, engines, profiles, affinity, and the config inventory. Measured footprints (resident_gpu_mib, host_rss_mib, device totals) are machine state and live in ~/.uap/model-registry.json, deep-merged over this file. A config without a measurement is 'unmeasured' and fails closed: it may be served if already resident, but it can never be loaded or evicted. See docs/specs/operator-model-placement.md §4.1.

dflash-q3_k_m.note: lucebox-hub DFlash speculative-decoding server (Qwen3.6-27B Q3_K_M target + draft head); machine profile: ~/.config/uap/dflash-server.env. The ugc-factory brain (pay2u tools/ugc-factory) requests 'qwen3.6-27b' through the UAP proxy, so placement auto-loads this config on demand — run `uap models measure` to record this machine's footprint before it can load (fail-closed). The Claude contract ids are advertised here too: the proxy serves them locally (ANTHROPIC_PASSTHROUGH_MODELS=__local_only__), and without a registry mapping the placement gate would 409-park every SDK client that checks /v1/models and then asks for one.

strata-iq3_s.note: active backend on this host; run `uap models measure` to record its footprint

strata-swift-iq3_s.note: Swift 1.5 (UkisAI reasoning-efficient Flash-Next post-train) GSQ-RCO IQ3_S on the strata engine; A/B trial vs strata-iq3_s since 2026-10-17 with identical tuning (spec 8/0.70, vram-reserve 3072, int8 KV resident 32768, 131k). Weights: ukisai Swift-1.5-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-GSQ-RCO-IQ3_S, sha256-verified, PLE table in shard 1 (setup-detected); pack strata-data/packs/swift-iq3_s; config strata-swift-iq3_s.json behind uap-strata-server.service (revert: point the unit --config back at strata-iq3_s.json, daemon-reload, restart). Run `uap models measure` to record this machine's footprint before it can load (fail-closed). Trial evidence: /home/cogtek/dev/strata/bench/results/2026-10-17-swift-iq3s-trial/.

strata-abliterated-iq2_xs.note: The LIVE :8080 default arm since 2026-10-28 (DavidAU abliterated Flash-Next at IQ2_XS, full expert pinning without the IQ3_S RAM-OOM risk; engine 0.1.52, config strata-abliterated-iq2_xs.json). Raw GGUF shards declared here: the pack (strata-data/packs/abliterated-iq2_xs) is derived from them by tools/iq_pack.py and rebuilds from these files; shard 2 is byte-identical across the repo's tiers (verified 2026-10-28).

ampere.note: ATX-IQ4_XS-M (4.56 bpw, llamAmpere-tuned recipe: bulk IQ4_XS, Q5_0/Q6_K attention K/V, Q8_0 GDN vectors) on llamAmpere v0.3, the engine+quant pair measured on this GPU class (3090/3090 Ti): 99.4 tok/s clean decode, 93.2 at 100K depth, exact p/q draft verification (output distribution = target's exactly). The 2-rail arm since 2026-10-30, measured live: -c 86016 total / -np 2 = 43008 per rail, q8_0 K + turbo3 V KV (the fused SM86 MMA path), MTP-3 spec decode (70.4% acceptance measured), engine 18,400 MiB with 3,072-3,156 MiB free beside the live desktop — ~52 tok/s solo decode engine-side at full 318W draw (2 rails buy concurrency, not aggregate). Unit ExecStartPre runs `uap models ensure-by-path` so a deleted GGUF re-downloads before the start fails.

openjet.note: OpenJet megakernel arm (:8080 default 2026-10-28 daytime, stood down evening for the strata switch-back). The Q4_K_M file under models/qwen3.8-27b-q4km went missing from disk after the arm was stood down — restored-on-demand via this manifest. unsloth deleted the file from main on 2026-08-19, so the source is the OpenJet catalog's pinned revision (open-jet src/config.py QWEN38_27B_URL).
